rows.Origin: Bred by Gordon Wilson Kirkham (United Kingdom, 1999).
rows.Bloom: Pink. Anise fragrance. In large clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Named for the popular weather presenter.
